KEO RPG 模組包的西班牙文翻譯材質包

輕量級材質包，將多個熱門模組翻譯成西班牙文。完全免費，可用於任何模組包。

已翻譯的模組：

  • Alloy Smelter
  • Armageddon
  • Block Factories & Bosses
  • Clavis
  • Critters and Companions
  • Deeper and Darker
  • Eidolon: Repraised
  • End Remastered
  • Eternal Starlight
  • Galosphere
  • Gobber 2
  • Handcrafted
  • Hominid
  • Kaleidoscope Cookery
  • Lilies Lucky Lures
  • Lucky's Showcase
  • Myths and Legends
  • Oreganized
  • Pastel
  • Realms of the Wild
  • Refurbished Furniture
  • Regions Unexplored
  • Relics RPG
  • Saints and Dragons
  • Skill Tree RPGs
  • Soul Incursion
  • Spell Engine
  • Sweety Archaeology
  • Unusual End
  • Waystones
  • Wild Nature
  • Yo Hooks

可與任何其他模組包相容。
